title: Combining Data in pandas With merge(), .join(), and concat()
description: Learn how to combine data in pandas with merge(), .join(), and concat(), and when to use each one to unify your Series and DataFrame objects.
summary: The Series and DataFrame objects in pandas are powerful tools for exploring and analyzing data. Part of their power comes from a multifaceted approach to combining separate datasets.
takeaways: When you want to combine data objects based on one or more keys, similar to what you’d do in a relational database, merge() is the tool you need.
If you’re feeling a bit rusty, then you can watch a quick refresher on DataFrames before proceeding.
You can use merge() anytime you want functionality similar to a database’s join operations.
